description: Generator-on-solid integration test — the AE model end-to-end. Creates a Solid layer on a 64x64 screen, adds the core.gen.linear_gradient generator (zero-input effect that replaces the solid's content), sets its colors via the type-generic SetEffectParam command (color payloads) and angle via SetEffectFloatParam, then asserts the composited screen matches the golden. Covers generator kind registration -> inputCount bake -> PASS 1.5 generator-led chain -> SetEffectParam color marshalling -> PASS 2. Static params only (no g_timeSeconds dependence). Slot 1 = the 64x64 screen (slot 0 is the solid's own RT). Regenerate with scripts/integration/record_effect_generator_solid.json.
